property_summary: For every caller and when sending exactly 10 ether to C.fallback, the reference contract accepts the call (call does not revert) and updates pastBlockTime (so pastBlockTime becomes > previous value); the mutant flips the msg.value check and will revert for msg.value == 10 ether, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require on msg.value from == 10 ether to != 10 ether so calls sending 10 ether now revert (and others succeed).
